about: Alphapress (hydralazine), by brand name only, is supplied six times from January to September 2026 to a 71-year-old woman.
Hydralazine (Alphapress) is supplied four times from December 2025 to May 2026 to a 73-year-old man, in the middle of a 14-month history.
No hydralazine is supplied: the similar names are hydrochlorothiazide (in Avapro HCT) and hydroxychloroquine (Plaquenil), which are different medicines, so the criterion is not met.
